subject: Procurement readiness & next steps: AcmeCloud mutual action plan
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Rogers <samantha.rogers@acmecloud.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement readiness & next steps: AcmeCloud mutual action plan

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement readiness and the commercial path. I've attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a procurement checklist.

Recap from our call:
- Goal: pilot Redwood inference for customer-facing summarization flows (prod in Q2).
- Expected committed throughput: ~5M tokens/month initially.
- Primary concerns: legal terms, security review (SOC2 + pen test evidence), and vendor onboarding for finance (PO issuance).

Open questions / asks for AcmeCloud:
1) Preferred commercial path: PO (preferred) or corporate card for initial pilot?
2) Interest in pursuing AWS Marketplace listing (would help procurement) or prefer direct PO vendor setup?
3) Primary procurement/billing contact and anticipated PO approver name/titles.
4) Any specific SSO/KMS/contract clauses we should flag early?

Proposed procurement timeline (high level):
- Week 0: Exchange MAP + Redwood provides procurement checklist and MSA draft (attached).
- Week 1-2: Legal review (MSA redlines).
- Week 1 (in parallel): Security review — we'll provide SOC2 report + ASV/pen test summary; you confirm any extra evidence needed.
- Week 2-3: Finance vendor setup and PO generation once legal signoff received.
- Target PO issuance by end of March (flexible based on legal).

Next steps (what I'll do):
- Share editable MAP and MSA draft (attached).
- Follow up with a short checklist for security artifacts.

Can you confirm (a) preferred payment path (PO vs card), (b) whether Marketplace helps or hinders procurement, and (c) the procurement contact? Once I have that I'll loop in Marissa to own the MAP cadence.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Email: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- AcmeCloud-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP draft)
- Redwood-Procurement-Checklist.pdf (procurement artifacts list)

From: Samantha Rogers <samantha.rogers@acmecloud.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmecloud.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & next steps: AcmeCloud mutual action plan

Dylan —

Thanks for the clear recap and the materials. Real quick answers from procurement side:

- Commercial path: we prefer a PO for enterprise purchases. Card payments are OK for small pilot spend but for visibility and tracking Finance will push for PO.
- Marketplace: we are open to AWS Marketplace but procurement needs pricing parity and clear invoicing terms — sometimes Marketplace introduces billing cadence differences. For speed to pilot, direct PO is easiest.
- Procurement contact / PO approver: Tom Ellis (cc'd) is our procurement lead; final PO approver will likely be Ashley Park (Dir, Finance). I'll confirm Ashley’s timeline but expect finance to handle vendor onboarding the week after legal signoff.

Tentative timeline from our side:
- Legal: 2 weeks for initial review (MSA redlines expected)
- Security: 1 week in parallel assuming SOC2 report + requested artifacts are provided
- Finance/vendor setup: 1 week after legal signoff to generate PO
- Target PO issuance: looking at Mar 29-31 if legal moves quickly

A few items for the MSA we'll prioritize: data retention limits, audit rights / logs, and termination for convenience terms. If you can flag alternative language upfront that would speed review.

I'll take a look at the MAP and checklist today. Tom — can you pick up vendor onboarding once legal confirms?

Best,
Samantha Rogers
Head of Product Partnerships | AcmeCloud
samantha.rogers@acmecloud.com

Thanks — looping in the next steps and a slightly updated MAP (see attached). A few items we've captured based on your notes:

Updated procurement milestones (signed MSA -> PO path):
